name: Csegöld (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Csegöld (a blue shield with a yellow letter L and a crescent, with a helm, a crest and blue and yellow mantling) below the word ÖNKORMÁNYZAT in yellow.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Csegöld arms with helm, crest and mantling
